notes.title: Update Notice v1.69.12.2
notes.notes:
Alert! The bug army has been defeated—here’s everything we’ve fixed in the latest updates:



UI & Localization

Fixed a bunch localization issues, including prompts in Chinese on the Privilege Bundle page, popup messages in Chinese etc.

Resolved a bunch of visual issues with the new postmatch statistics, such as overlapping avatars on the frames, incorrect display of the chests received and incorrect display of the Neutral victory screen

Fixed the bug that caused players to have the same colour during meetings

Fixed the bug that caused functional buttons to dissapear from the interface

Fixed the problem in Steam version, that caused incorrect display of the emotes during meetings

Resolved a problem that caused players without SP to have a golden nickname

Resolved a display issue with the avatar special effect for top 100 players in the leaderboard

Removed Chinese prompts in Colosseum Pass interface



Functional Issues

Fixed an issue with the display of player region in matches 

Removed a bug that didn't allow players to use microphone properly in matches

Fixed a problem with Godfather's MVP sound effect

Fixed a problem with Hacker's epic ability, as it had no effect

Resolved an issue with the room owner connection in Private mode

Fixed a problem that caused iOS players to experience crashes during meetings in game

Removed a bug that caused Guardian (with epic ability only) to lose all of his ability charges after reconnection to match

Resolved the problem with missing action and ability buttons

Fixed the Mayor's bug that caused Mayor to lost it's additional vote

Resolved the issue with the game crashes while trying to log in

Resolved the problem with Time Assasin's ability that caused players not to be able to use it

Fixed the bug with Spy's epic skill

Fixed the issue with game's main menu sound, players reported there was no sound at all

Fixed the same sound issue within matches too

Fixed the bug that occurred in Private mode, when host was kicked from the room automatically

Fixed the problem in Colosseum that caused players not to be able to use Shield, when Sniper activates Snipe ability

Resolved the issue with the Bounty Hunter's ability that caused Bounty's target to constantly change

Fixed the bug with Monkey King's ability as many players have reported that it had no effect

Fixed the problem that iOS users experienced with hotpatches, i.e updates that do not require downloading new version from the store. Users reported that they couldn't see new content after these hotpatches

Fixed the issue with Sniper's role skin, when the special visual effect of the ability wasn't coming off even after the end of ability

Resolved another visual problem with Sniper's ability, when it's "scope effect" wasn't appearing sometimes

Resolved visual issue with backpack icons in the Vault, when some backpacks has been dissapearing

Fixed the problem that some players reported, when new comment notification led players to their comment page, even when the new comment was actually on other player's page

Fixed the visual issue with "No Blinking" pose by adding a cane to the model

Fixed the visual issue with the "Galaxy Pledge" name box as players reported frames of the name box weren't even

Fixed the issue when there were no Neutral roles in the All Roles mode

Fixed the bug that caused Time Master's epic skill not to have an effect

Fixed the bug with the cameras, if Time Master skill was used as player was checking the cameras then affected player will always see the cameras in front of him

Resolved issue with the dissapearing sound after the minimizing the game

Resolved visual issue when players have chosen small body type, but the name boxes still were displayed with the big body type

Fixed the epic skill of the Blackjack (1st epic module) as players reported that it doesn't improves survival chance

Fixed the visual bug that caused Superpass avatar frames not to have effects on the Superpass leaderboard

Fixed the bug that caused main screen to go black after opening the surprise chest

Resolved visual issue with the "Battle Front" loading page as many players reported it's appearance have changed

Resolved visual issue with the Gift Royale when Goldstars count appeared twice

Fixed the bug that caused players not to be able to send messages in Private mode lobbies

Fixed visual issues with the "Frost Brush" name effect

Removed a glitch that allowed players to stuck inside the computer in the lobby room before match

Fixed the sound effects in Role section of the menu as players reported some roles don't have a sound effect when clicking on them

Resolved the problem with key bindings of Light Warrior and Dark Emperor abilities in the Steam version

Removed visual glitch with the Conjurer's ability as cursed players reported it's ability button to appear after the curse, as if they can transfer the curse to other players

Fixed the bug that caused players controlled by Puppeteer not to be able to use Kill

Fixed the bug that caused Sniper to walk improperly while using her Snipe ability along with the second epic module, that allows Sniper to walk during the Snipe

Fixed the display problem with different royale pages (e.g. Ink Hero, Maiden of Rosa etc.) as some players reported they can see numbers just below the royale interface

Fixed visual issue that caused some outfits to have enormously long neck, while new pet Lina was equipped

Fixed the bug that caused "Sakura Dreams" chat bubble to have display problems

Resolved problem with the lack of visual effects and sounds of the actions

Fixed the problem with the Kaiju's walking animation after the transformation that some players reported



Events & Items

Resolved a display issue with the Blackjack's role skin main art 

Updated arts for the Flashbang and Puppeteer role cards

Fixed a bug with the access to Superpass exclusive roles 

Resolved a problem with walking animation for some recent skins, including Phoenix Serenade skins

Fixed ability animations for Gluttony, Fiend and Puppeteer role skins

Fixed a display issue with Melting Snow chat bubble, which caused text to slide rightward



Thanks for sticking with us — now get out there and enjoy a bug-free experience (well, almost 😉).

notes.title: Super Sus Update Notice: What's Big, Free, and Shoots Lasers?
notes.notes:
Hey Crewmates!

Make sure you’re on the latest version 1.65.23.042 so you don’t miss a thing. Let’s dive in!

🆕Patch Notes

- New Role: Godfather. He’s here. He’s powerful. And yes — he’s free. Instantly shuts down discussions and secretly learns a Crewmate’s role after every meeting. Stay sharp — the Godfather always knows more than you think.
 (👏 Big thanks to the game designers for finally turning player feedback into reality — again!)
 
- New Map: Memoria. Time travel between Old Town and New Town in this timeline-hopping map! Explore brand-new tasks (ever tried bargaining with an NPC?) and beware of the Runaway Vehicle — getting hit is not recommended.
 
- Kaiju Returns! After vanishing into the sea (and the patch notes) for a while, Kaiju is back — now stomping into the shop! This fan-favorite role transforms and fires lasers. Get it while you can!

 

🛠️ Bug Destroyer:

1. UI & Localization
- Fixed visual issue in Golden Royale that mislabeled exchange tokens as Astrocoins
- A problem occurred in the Colosseum menu, which led to neverfading notice of an unclaimed reward (small red dot) was resolved
- Fixed a bunch of minor localization problems, skill prompts, event prompts etc.
- Fixed the golden name effect bugs
- Fixed the interface issue with the chat button in Super Ludo mode
- Foxed the bug that the Annual Gala fullscreen effect wasn't able to display on the fullscreen

2. In-match problems
- Fixed an issue in the Steam version where the Prankster skill couldn’t be bound to the hotkey, requiring players to click with mouse
- Fixed a bug in the rank protection mechanism where only five matches were being protected instead of the intended six
- Fixed a security camera bug in Magic Castle map where players got stuck due to camera becoming unresponsive to exit, forcing players to restart the game
- Fixed an issue where dead players' names and text appeared too faint during meetings, making them hard to read
- Fixed delayed response times for all combat actions (shields/weapons/skills) in the Colosseum game mode
- Fixed the problem with Super Pass experience calculation that some players have encountered recently
- Fixed the problem with the incorrect effect of the Blackjack's Fearless Gambler epic skill, which didn't allow to use Guess twice when applicable
- Fixed a bug that some players experienced on the Magic Castle map, which led to game stuck and crash everytime using the magic mirror
- Fixed a few UI and localization bugs, mostly display of numbers instead of text on some buttons, icons etc.
- Fixed the bug that allowed players to walk behind the console in the Weapons rooms on the Spaceship
- Fixed a problem with UI during the meetings, buttons were displaced and unavailable to press

3. Others
- Fixed the visual problem with the Dementor's role skin
- Fixed an issue where dead players' names appeared too faint during meetings, making them hard to read
- Fixed incorrect walking animations (again!) for Flying Aspara, Alice, Anux and a few other skins.
- Fixed missing sound effects for the Festive Flair action
- Fixed a bug with the Queen's Reign dance from the topup event
- Fixed a visual issue in Astro Mining event that displayed white blocks instead of the already opened tiles



Keyboards are smoking, bugs are running — our devs are on it! Hang tight, fixes are rolling out faster than a vent gets sus’d. If you run into any more glitches, weird timeline stuff, or suspicious fishy behavior (not the shark, he’s cool), hit us up on Discord!

notes.title: Snowflake Tale: Christmas & New Year Update
notes.notes:
Dear Spacecrews and Impostors,

The winter is here, and it's time to celebrate in style! Snowflake Tale invites you to step into a frosty wonderland filled with magical surprises, festive cheer, and unforgettable adventures. Here's what awaits you in this exciting update:

🎄 Christmas Delights ❄️🎁

 ASTROLOGY CHAMBER - CAPRICORN
 NOCTURNAL REVERIE
 NEW ROLES
 ADVENTURER AND GREYJACK
 SUPER PASS M6 PRE-ORDER
 CHRISTMAS GIFT ROYALE
 NEW YEAR TOP-UP REWARDS
 FREE SKIN
 CHRISTMAS SALE


🔧Bug Destroyer

Modes and Matches Issues

 Fixed problem with resetting excluded gimmicks in the room
 Various game crashes in the Super Ludo are now fixed
 A problem which caused Superpass holders not to obtain double amount of trophies in matches is fixed
 A problem which caused Superpass holders not to obtain Pass Shield
 Fixed problem with the roundtable on Halloween map, which caused players to stuck inside the table
 Fixed a series of bugs that caused players to stuck in the places like: 1) various walls on the Spaceship after Time Master uses her ability; 2) stairs in the Sutra Library of the Dragon's Island; 3) small area on the beach of the Dragon's Island; 4) behind the tree in O2 room of the Mars Base
 Fixed a few bugs that appeared in matches: 1) Krakenburg's elevator bug that caused players to go out of bounds while trying to hop on the elevator; 2) the "Bubble" backpack problem which caused players wearing it to be seen by others outside the viewing area; 3) ability special effect display problem on Honey Bee's "Freespirit" role skin


Visual Issues

 Visual issues with Private Rooms interface
 Abilities CD display bug was fixed
 A bunch of Super Ludo UI problems were fixed, including: 1) players nicknames are now visible in Super Ludo chat interface; 2) Super Ludo rooms are now showing correct amount of players in the room; 2) repeating auto-text prompts
 Fixed the bug which caused Super Pass M5's page featuring a skin which is not a part of the Super Pass M5
 A problem with "Halo Hop" avatar frame's display was fixed
 Super Pass M5 skins naming issue in Indonesian version


Others

 Part of players haven't received correct rewards for the Black Friday top-up event. Affected players have received compensation.
 Language mistakes


It starts on Dec 24th. Don’t miss out on holiday gifts! The snow is falling, and the magic is calling! Gather your friends and join us in making this holiday season unforgettable.

                                                                                                                                      Warm wishes,
                                                                                                                                      Super Sus Team
